parsed.evidence_quote: The purified R2lox apoproteins (both WT and G68L mutant) were incubated with metal salts so as to generate four types of metalloprotein samples
WT_MnFe; WT_FeFe; G68L_MnFe; G68L_FeFe
Mutation of the glycine to leucine converts the resting state R2lox cofactor into an R2c-like cofactor
which is directly impacted by the metalation state of the protein
